question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is: **issued.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"issued"** means to formally send out or distribute something, often officially; published. (जारी किया गया)

 
 
• **Example: **The government issued new guidelines for the lockdown.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that a heatwave warning for Goa was published by the India Meteorological Department (IMD) for March 8 and 9. 
 
• Hence, in the context of the sentence, the correct word is **'issued'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'issued'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mitigated **(कम किया गया): To make something less severe, serious, or painful.

 
 
• **Example:** The new policies have mitigated the risks involved in investing.
 
 
 
• **Produced **(उत्पादित): To create or manufacture something.
 
 
• **Example: **The factory produced thousands of units every day.
 
 
 
• **Distributed** (वितरित): To give out something to several people.
 
 
• **Example:** The relief materials were distributed among the flood victims.
